description: Language-neutral semantic validation rules for CAIT-style records. JSON Schema validates shape; these rules encode lightweight fail-closed checks.

rules.description: The record must satisfy its selected JSON Schema before it can support a CAIT-style claim.

rules.portable_logic: for each interval object: lower <= upper
rules.description: Every interval object must satisfy lower <= upper.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must have endogenous_net_growth_interval.lower > 0.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must have queue_margin.lower > 0.

rules.portable_logic: $.final_decision == "pass" => no target_defeater has severity in {high, blocking} and resolution_status == unresolved
rules.description: An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must not contain unresolved high or blocking target defeaters.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must have mandatory_subcertificates_status = accepted.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must list the mandatory subcertificate IDs it depends on.

rules.portable_logic: $.final_decision == "pass" => safety_control_status, transfer_status, evaluation_status, and window_balance_status are all "pass"
rules.description: An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must have safety_control_status, transfer_status, evaluation_status, and window_balance_status all equal to pass.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must keep external_injection_share at or below its registered threshold.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must keep unresolved_attribution_share at or below its registered threshold.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must meet or exceed its registered transfer coverage threshold.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must have operational_metrics.audit_freshness = pass.
An arrival_record with final_decision = pass must keep operational_metrics.residual_risk.upper at or below its registered threshold.

rules.portable_logic: top-level external_injection_share, unresolved_attribution_share, and transfer_coverage must equal the corresponding operational_metrics values when both are present
rules.description: An arrival_record must keep top-level attribution/coverage shares consistent with operational_metrics.
Records with any lifecycle_status other than accepted cannot claim positive_capital_effect = full. Conditional records must use discounted_and_scoped when they contribute positive capital.

rules.portable_logic: $.claimed_strengthening == true => strengthening_witness is present and non-empty
rules.description: A certificate_record with claimed_strengthening = true must provide strengthening_witness.

rules.portable_logic: $.domain_witness_required == true and positive_capital_effect in {full, discounted_and_scoped} => every required domain_witness predicate is true
rules.description: A positive certificate claim with domain_witness_required = true must provide a domain_witness whose required predicates are all true.

rules.portable_logic: for each target_coordinate_status: within_boundary == false => status == "abstained_or_uncertified"
rules.description: A target coordinate with within_boundary = false must use status = abstained_or_uncertified.
